title: HOOK v2 (0:00-1:03) · Rokossovsky #8 · something new every 2-4 s
note: mm:ss = video time; option 1 = territory colours (wide), option 2 = glowing two-colour front lines (close-up); zoom whoosh only on the 3 biggest moves
frames: FIRST FRAME: Belarus Jun 44 (opt 1), red vs blue line, flags + legend up, blue already moving
BIG card SLAMS in at 0.3 s, ticks 0 -> ~400,000 GERMAN SOLDIERS LOST (small: whole op.)
'Lost': wave 1, north red counters hit, crack and grey; blue counters push in
'single summer': IN ONE SUMMER stamp; wave 2 explodes in the centre
'a swamp': hard zoom DIVE into the Pripyat marsh; switch to option 2 glowing front line, close-up flags
'sure no army': German screen pulses, IMPASSABLE slams on the marsh, German belief caption
'In June 1944': 24 JUNE date, log roads draw across the bog one by one
'one Soviet general': mystery '?' badge (name withheld); 'tanks and cavalry' burst out along the roads
'straight through': ALERT, target rings, MG fire on the screen, impacts, arrows north
'Three days later': WHITE-FLASH cut into the flash-forward, 27 JUNE 1944, Bobruisk
two blue arrows race round Bobruisk, the ring SLAMS shut on 'trapped'
TRAPPED stamp, impacts inside the pocket, pocket units grey
'Within weeks': zoom-out; option 1 (4 July): only the Minsk pocket + far west still German
big arrows sweep west; ARMY GROUP CENTRE; red ghost arrow '1941: AT THE GATES OF MOSCOW'
'torn apart': explosions rip the remnants, ARMY GROUP CENTRE struck through
hook-3 HARD CUT to dark: 'SEVEN YEARS EARLIER' 1944 rolls back to 1937
'prison cell': photo badge, prison bars SLAM down over the screen
NKVD card ('Stalin's secret police'), ARRESTED AUGUST 1937 stamp
family caption; TEETH / RIBS / MOCK EXECUTION x2 (one per word); NEVER SIGNED... (boom)
hit x4 + shake, ref:boom; bars lift at 0:43.8 (ref:whoosh)
hook-4: map lights up, badge out of the cell, KONSTANTIN ROKOSSOVSKY name SLAMS in
'In four years': badge flies to the corner; 'from that cell': MARCH 1940 RELEASED FROM PRISON
CUT 1 Moscow, Dec 1941: red arrows driven in, stopped (impacts, greyed), ring MOSCOW 1941
CUT 2 Kursk, Jul 1943: red pincers from Orel + Belgorod broken, ring KURSK 1943
CUT 3 Bobruisk, Jun 44: blue arrows burst west, red ground torn away, ring BOBRUISK 1944
pull-out to all three rings, title SLAMS: ROKOSSOVSKY'S 3 GREATEST TACTICAL MOVES
